methodology: source-first, independent, no Headroom output consulted. Each of the three source contracts (doc-a, doc-b, doc-c) was read in full from the extracted-text .txt files using sequential offset/limit reads covering every line of every document. Claims were catalogued per-document; where a provision is textually identical (or immaterially reworded) across two or more documents it is recorded once against the most recent document with amendmentOperativeStateRelevance noting its origin and any later divergence. Where the substance of a provision changed, was added, or was removed between versions, that change is captured as its own claim (often tagged covenantFamily=amendment-effect) in addition to the base claim, so the delta itself is independently checkable. All sourceEvidence quotes are verbatim substrings copied from the extracted-text files; none are paraphrased.

operativeStateAssessment.reasoning: Doc-c's own recitals state that Riot and Coinbase Credit 'are parties to a Credit Agreement dated as of April 22, 2025, as amended and restated as of the First Amendment and Restatement Effective Date (this Agreement in the form as of the First Amendment and Restatement Effective Date, the "Existing Credit Agreement", and as in effect on the Original Effective Date, the "Original Credit Agreement") and...have agreed to amend and restate the Existing Credit Agreement with effect from the Second Amendment and Restatement Effective Date as follows.' Doc-c Section 1.05 (Amendment and Restatement) confirms: 'The Existing Credit Agreement shall be amended and restated in the form of this Agreement with effect from the Second Amendment and Restatement Effective Date. Upon the effectiveness of this Agreement, the terms and provisions of the Existing Credit Agreement shall be superseded hereby... this Agreement shall not be deemed to evidence or result in a novation or repayment and re-borrowing of those obligations. All references to the "Credit Agreement" or any similar term contained in the Loan Documents shall be deemed to refer to this Agreement.' This creates an explicit, self-described three-link restatement chain: doc-a (Original Credit Agreement, 4/22/2025) -> doc-b (Existing Credit Agreement as of the First Amendment and Restatement Effective Date, 5/19/2025) -> doc-c (this Agreement, effective as of the Second Amendment and Restatement Effective Date, dated 4/21/2026), with each later document expressly superseding and restating its predecessor in full while preserving the same underlying, continuing (non-novated) obligations. Doc-b's own recitals make the identical statement one link earlier ('Borrower and Lender are parties to a Credit Agreement dated as of April 22, 2025 (the "Existing Credit Agreement") and...have agreed to amend and restate the Existing Credit Agreement with effect from the Amendment and Restatement Effective Date'). Because doc-c is dated closest to the 'as of' date given in the task (2026-04-21) and is, by its own terms, the document currently superseding and restating both predecessors, doc-c is the operative agreement as of 2026-04-21. Note that doc-c's own effectiveness is itself conditioned on satisfaction of the Section 3.04 conditions precedent for the 'Second Amendment and Restatement Effective Date' (which the document defines but does not, in the text provided, affirmatively recite as already satisfied elsewhere in the four corners of the document) — this reviewer is relying on the document's own self-description as the then-current form of agreement, consistent with the instruction not to resolve amendment/operative-state logic beyond what the documents' own recitals say.
